raw_prompt: !create add boots that when I walk it spawns primed tnt behind me (like 2 blocks behind, so a trail)
reviewer_feedback: Created custom diamond boots that spawn a trail of primed TNT behind the player while walking.
usage_instructions: Use /get-tnt-boots as an operator to receive the special boots.
Equip the 'TNT Trail Boots' to start spawning TNT behind you.
Walk around to leave a trail of primed TNT in your wake.

mutations.content:
command /get-tnt-boots:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give 1 of diamond boots named "&cTNT Trail Boots" with lore "&7Leaves a trail of destruction behind you." to player

every 5 ticks:
    loop all players:
        if loop-player's boots is diamond boots named "&cTNT Trail Boots":
            if block under loop-player is not air:
                set {_loc} to location of loop-player
                set {_back} to location 2 meters behind loop-player
                spawn primed tnt at {_back}
                play sound "entity.tnt.primed" with volume 0.5 to loop-player

traces.intent_summary: Create a custom boot item that spawns primed TNT behind the player as they walk.

traces.rationale: I created a script that checks every 5 ticks if a player is wearing the specific custom boots. If they are, it calculates a location 2 meters behind the player and spawns a primed TNT entity there. I used a command to allow the user to obtain the item, identifying it by its specific name and type.
